en.topic_title: Who is Alice Huang, the Chinese tech executive accused of spying on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang?
en.topic_summary:
Tech executive Alice Huang is the woman accused of spying for China during an affair with Jensen Huang, head of US artificial intelligence chip titan Nvidia, according to media reports.



Alice Huang (R), a Chinese executive linked to the data centre company called Megaspeed, attending a dinner hosted by Nvidia’s chief executive and co-founder Jensen Huang (L in black back facing camera) at a restaurant in Taipei on May 22, 2025. Photo: AFP.
